exact_tick_contemporaneous_mid.definition: per-tick midpoint x2=bid+ask; bar H/L from extrema of contemporaneous midpoint ticks

asynchronous_envelope_mid.definition: bar midpoint H/L reconstructed from independently aggregated bid/ask extrema: H2=bid_high+ask_high; L2=bid_low+ask_low

localized_partition_change.effect: these identities form one alias class under asynchronous-envelope MID but split into two classes under exact contemporaneous MID

interpretation.important_caveat: diagnostic identity hashing/partition reconstruction is not asserted byte-identical to the historical Stage1 runner; therefore this receipt does not by itself authorize rewriting the frozen Stage1 authority

scientific_decision: DO_NOT_CHANGE_PREREGISTERED_SIGNAL_RULES. Treat M5_MID plus-one as implementation-semantics discrepancy. Recover historical Stage1 runner/mask ledger if available; otherwise build a byte-equivalent Stage1 identity reproducer before deciding which lineage is authoritative. Exact contemporaneous MID remains required for corrected economic execution unless a preregistered feature definition explicitly states otherwise.
